name: Yatagarasu
source:
A pure youkai. Yatakarasu literally means an eight-handed crow, and is a god in the Shinto mythology.
In the game he's a huge three legged crow disguised as a man. He's an envoy sent to Japan by Amaterasu. Even though he's extremely childish and spoiled, he's over 2000 years old. Inheriting Shizu's roles and accompanied by Karasutengu, he shoulders the responsibility of commanding the youkais. He's on good terms with the politicians, and he's feasible to work as one. He's in a fierce battle with Ten who [spoiler]killed Shizu, but their fight isn't concluded due to the latter's injury. Similarly how Ten lost most of his power, Yatakarasu too lost his magical powers: when he takes human form, he's limited to the body of a child[/spoiler].
Has a rivalry with Kisaragi Soushichi over Suzu.
